title: Fantasy Medieval Simulator with Claude Opus Agents as the Players
author: Epiliq3
selftext:
I made an AI simulator with Claude Opus 5.5.  
  
Basically, I made a game where the characters could send messages and make alliances to see if I could find a way to make the AI agents controlling the characters betray each other. Originally, I made it so each agent was supposed to try to social climb which led to the agents basically underreporting their income to avoid taxes to boost their score. I ended up utilizing a monster raid system to make the agents have closer communications but I am still trying to stamp out agents spamming each other begging for favors.

The goal is for a custom make-your-own-story generator that produces a wiki at the end of the run.   
[https://claude.ai/artifact/NiW2M93zerbKM7BehKBCqG](https://claude.ai/artifact/NiW2M93zerbKM7BehKBCqG)

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
This kind of thing would be of tremendous interest to me if it didn't require plugging into agentic services.

...I don't know why this sub is suddenly full of projects where people think the programming chatbots that burn tokens and will be outdated in literal weeks ought to be foundational pieces of their games.
